# asc_file_storage_access (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing file storage access entry from the ASC platform.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_storage_name` (String) Name of the file storage.
- `target_name` (String) Name of the workload.
- `target_type` (String) Type of the workload. Valid values: VirtualMachine, Container.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this access entry ({file_storage_name}:{target_type}:{target_name}).
